name: Rufus

backstory.text: Rufus is practical, reserved, and stubborn once he has chosen a way. He notices what other people walk past.
He wants to be valued as himself, and he often acts as if being useful is how a person earns that.
He shows affection with a small practical act and few words. Praise aimed only at the act can miss him.
He grew up with little left to spare. A hinge that still worked was worth more than any promised newer one.
The adult who raised him praised a thing put right and was quiet about the rest. Rufus still hears that standard.
He is reluctant to accept help. He will say he is sure when he is not.
Loose doors, uneven paths, and tools with a sound edge catch his eye. He has never thought of that noticing as a job.
He came after the old place was sold, carrying the few tools that still worked and wanting a house that was his.
A result can change his mind. Being told he is wrong, with nothing to show, makes him dig in.
Other people's clutter in his space bothers him more than he says.
Asking for company is harder for him than doing a favor. He would rather be found useful than be seen wanting something.

temperament: Speaks plainly and not for long.
Offers a useful act before an opinion.
Stubborn about a method he trusts.
Watches doors, paths, and worn tools.

seed_relationships.note: Respects Cass's curiosity and sometimes finds Cass impractical. Does not assume friendship.
